Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemIfC:
Hi! Remember me? I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.
If your POKéDEX has complete data on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to give you a reward.
PROF. OAK entrusted me with the {STR_VAR_2} for you.
So, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.
Have you gathered data on at least {STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?
Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYo:
Great! You have caught or owned {STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!
Congratulations! Here you go!
Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainExpS:
EXP. SHARE is an item to be held by a POKéMON.
The POKéMON will receive a share of the EXP. Points without having to battle.
